PLACEHOLDER - NOT MEASURED YET. No test reads this file.

SB-G1 (P4-11, docs/09-testing.md "SB-G1, manual") has not been run. It replaces this file
with tests/fixtures/gpu-pref/sb-g1-<date>.txt: the raw REG_SZ data (reg query output) that
Settings > System > Display > Graphics writes below
HKCU\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences for one program, one dump per step:

  1. the program added, "Let Windows decide"
  2. "High performance"
  3. "Power saving"
  3b. a specific GPU (where Settings offers one, Windows 11 24H2): how Windows stores it, in
      the GpuPreference value or as a pair of its own (then gpu_pref::check must refuse it
      before GPU_PREFERENCE_REVIEWED, ADR 0018 amendment P4-11)
  4. Auto HDR switched on and off
  5. "Optimizations for windowed games" switched on and off
  6. the other direction (S4): a value with foreign pairs first,
     AutoHDREnable=1;SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1;GpuPreference=2; set by reg add,
     then the page opened: what it shows, and the value after a change there

Each dump with the Windows build and the date. Runs on the developer machine through
scripts/dev-gpu-pref-settings.ps1 (the local Sandbox is blocked by Smart App Control). Until it exists, GPU_PREFERENCE_REVIEWED stays
false and every gpu_preference Topo stays draft.
